Made with ancient technology, it boasts a high rate of fire and firepower, but has low durability.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Locations and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 50 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Guard's Bow}} Royal Guard's Bows are a powerful type of [[Bow]]s found within [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. A Royal Guard's Bow, spawns above the fireplace in [[Princess Zelda's Room]]. Another one spawns inside the [[Square Spiral Staircase]]. Royal Guard's Bows belong to the [[Royal Guard's Series]] equipment archetype, which is associated with the [[Royal Guard]] of [[Hyrule]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} Prior to the second [[Great Calamity]], Royal Guard's Bows were made by the [[Sheikah]] using [[Ancient Technology]] to fight [[Calamity Ganon]]. Royal Guard's Bows make a trade between firepower and Durability, as they have a higher strength but has lower Durability. If [[Link]] speaks to [[Parcy]] at [[Riverside Stable]], she will tell him about the Weapons once used by the Royal Guards of Hyrule Castle, expressing sadness she could never find any of them.{{Cite|Have you gone to the giant castle north of here? That's Hyrule Castle. It's said to have fallen to ruin over a hundred years ago. I used to sneak in there to salvage ancient treasures, but it's too dangerous to go in there now. These days it's surrounded by an eerie mist and savage machine-like creatures. Back when it was safer, I went in looking for this ultra-rare equipment that once belonged to the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard}}. It's legendary among collectors, but I was never able to find any...|Parcy|BotW}} This will begin "[[The Royal Guard's Gear]]" [[Side Quest]]. Royal Guard's Bows are one of the Weapons Link can bring Parcy. She will recognize it immediately, asking to see it.{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that bow you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}} If Link allows her to, she will thank him and express a desire to find her own pieces of the Royal Guard's Series.{{Cite|Thank you. You have shown me something truly spectacular. I need to go out and find one of these myself.|Parcy|BotW}} Parcy will give him a [[Gold Rupee]] as a reward.{{Cite|Here's a token of my appreciation.|Parcy|BotW}} Following this exchange, Link can trade Royal Guard's Bows to Parcy for a [[Topaz]], a [[Ruby]], or a [[Sapphire]].{{Cite|Hey, that bow... Will you trade it for a topaz?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Hey, that bow... Will you trade it for a ruby?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Hey, that bow... Will you trade it for a sapphire?|Parcy|BotW}} Royal Guard's Bows are made of metal, and will therefore conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, they will not burn if they touch [[Fire]] or if they are exposed to a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_033" |Life = 20 |Power = 50 |Range = 30.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 11 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 20 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 30 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.5 |ArrowReloadRate = 0.8 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 50 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Royal Guard's Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} Royal Guard's Bows reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Technology * Bow * Royal Guard's Series }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Bows, Royal Guard's Series |items= BotW, TotK }}
